title: Book Wyrm’s Birthday Gift
hook: Trollskull Alley is filled with laughter, singing, and pouring of drinks as a party is in full swing. Sitting at a large table is anuncomfortable dragonborn who ni bbles on a piece of chocolate cake, then smiles as an inebriated couple walks up to him and shouts “Happy Birthday!” As you walk further into the party, a human wearing a trenchcoat greets you with a smile while holding a leather bound tome.

npcs.name: Roland Lhal
npcs.role: Parks and Recreation Guest Services Coordinator
